name: 92646 · Huntingtn Bch, CA
findings: ZIP 92646 (Huntingtn Bch) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92646 (Huntingtn Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92646 (Huntingtn Bch) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
